title: Modified CTAB Procedure for Extraction of Plant DNA from Bird Feces
author: Carina Motta
materials: Preparation of Materials Verify that all solutions are prepared and autoclaved material is available Turn on the dry bath to 65°C Prepare three identical sets of numbered tubes (2 sets of 2 mL tubes and 1 set of 1.5 mL tubes) Record in the lab notebook the correspondence between the tube numbers and sample IDs
Let the pellet sit immersed for 2 minutes.
Let the pellet sit immersed for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh 50 to 100 mg (~80 mg) of fecal material for each sample directly into the tube and add 200 μL of sample alcohol.

steps.title: First Organic Extraction (CIA I)
steps.instruction: Perform the first extraction using chloroform-isoamyl alcohol (CIA) in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Allow samples to reach room temperature.
Add 600 μL of CIA (chloroform-isoamyl alcohol 24:1).
Centrifuge at maximum speed (13,000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Carefully remove tubes from the centrifuge without disturbing the interface between the two phases.
Add 600 μL of CIA (chloroform-isoamyl alcohol 24:1).
Centrifuge at maximum speed (13,000 rpm) for 10 minutes.
Carefully remove tubes from the centrifuge without disturbing the interface between the two phases.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the nucleic acids using salts and isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/2 volume of 6M NaCl (~270 μL) and 1/10 volume (54 μL) of 3M sodium acetate.
Add 2/3 volume of cold isopropanol (-20°C) (~400 μL).
Mix gently.
Place tubes in a -20°C freezer for 2 hours.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the precipitated DNA pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 minutes to form a pellet.
Carefully pour off as much supernatant as possible without losing the pellet.
Wash the pellet with 500 μL of 70% ethanol.
Wash the pellet with 500 μL of 100% ethanol.

steps.title: Dry and Store Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol and store the sample.

substeps.instruction: Place open tubes in a dry bath (65°C) for ~2 hours until alcohol evaporates.
Store in freezer at -20°C.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Break down the sample using CTAB buffer and Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 μL of CTAB buffer and 20 μL of Proteinase K with 10 porcelain beads.
Place in the Minibeater for 5 minutes.
Incubate in a water bath at 60°C overnight (~12 hours).

steps.title: Phase Separation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate the aqueous phase from the organic components.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the tubes and invert for 5 minutes (at least 20 times) until a homogeneous emulsion forms.
Pipette the upper (aqueous) phase into a new tube by withdrawing four fixed aliquots of 180 μL (~720 μL total).

steps.title: Third Organic Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a further organic solvent extraction in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 μL of CIA (chloroform-isoamyl alcohol 24:1).
Vortex the tubes and invert for 5 minutes (at least 20 times) until a homogeneous emulsion forms.
Pipette the upper (aqueous) phase into a new tube by withdrawing three fixed aliquots of 180 μL (~540 μL total).
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 13,000 rpm.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13,000 rpm.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in TE buffer containing RNase.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the elution buffer by mixing 49.5 μL of TE with 0.5 μL of RNase (multiply by number of samples).
Resuspend the pellet in 50 μL of this TE with RNase mixture.
